tasks.description: Install @mui/x-scheduler@9.0.0-beta.15 (--save-exact) with nested override {"@mui/x-scheduler": {"@mui/x-internals": "9.17.0"}} (fall back to global 9.17.0 if npm ignores nesting; verify with npm ls @mui/x-internals), node-ical@0.27.6 as exact devDependency, and add `import type {} from '@mui/x-scheduler/theme-augmentation'` beside the theme. Nothing else is added.

Prisma: add enums AudienceType (PRD-12 values), EventCategory, Recurrence, RsvpResponse and models CalendarEvent (incl. rsvpReminderSentAt D-1), EventAudience (D-2 indexes), EventRsvp (@@id[eventId,userId]), CalendarFeedToken, User back-relations with cascades (D-4); generate migration 20261113000000_add_calendar.

Add schoolMidnight(dateStr, tz) and schoolDateOf(instant, tz) to src/lib/dates.ts; create client-safe Zod validators mirroring api-contracts components (EventInput, EventPatch, RsvpInput, AudienceInput 1..20, calendarQuery ≤100 days + sources subset, schoolDayQuery, publicEventsQuery). Unit tests incl. DST-week all-day conversion.

Pure expandOccurrences(event, from, to, tz): wall-clock WEEKLY (+7d) / MONTHLY (same day, skip short months), until inclusive, occurrence id `${eventId}:${startISO}`. Unit tests: weekly, monthly on 31st, until bound, DST week.

Pure iCal builder: escapeText, foldLine (75 octets, CRLF), vtimezone, vevent (VALUE=DATE exclusive end for all-day, UTC Z for one-off, TZID+RRULE for series, zero-duration deadline with URL), buildCalendar. Unit tests parse output with node-ical.

Audience resolver at the PRD-12 path: resolveAudienceUserIds, isUserInAudience, audienceWhereForUser (keys precomputed once, OR filter in SQL), canTargetAudience (ADMIN any; TEACHER COURSE via assertCanManageCourse or homeroom SECTION). Unit test for canTargetAudience.
Register notification types event.created (defaultEmail false), event.holiday_created (true), event.updated (false), event.rsvp_reminder (false); COMMUNICATION, all roles.

calendar-service: getEvent/createEvent/updateEvent/deleteEvent (admin-only fields, canTargetAudience, creator/ADMIN guard, isNoSchool default, all-day conversion, $transaction, audit on admin edits of others' events, event.created/holiday_created/updated notify), upsertRsvp/listRsvps, isSchoolDay, noSchoolDays, createTermBreaks (idempotent, audited, no notify), getOrCreateFeedToken/resetFeedToken/findUserByFeedToken (randomBytes(32) + hashToken). Must NOT import timetable-service.

sources.ts: getCalendarItems(user, range, sources, studentId?, {series}) merging events (audience-filtered, expanded or series mode), holidays, assignments, quizzes, timetable (week only, skipping noSchoolDays) in parallel, with childName prefix for parents; getPublicEvents (public-safe fields); getUpcomingEventsForUser (now..+90d, events+holidays).

sendRsvpReminders(now): events with rsvpDeadline in (now, now+48h] and rsvpReminderSentAt null, claim via conditional updateMany, notify audience minus responders. Hook into dispatch cron in an isolated try/catch; summary gains rsvpReminders {events, notified}.

Replace both inline weekday checks at the 'PRD-14 holidays hook' lines in getScheduleForDate/getSchoolScheduleForDate with `if (!(await isSchoolDay(date)).isSchoolDay) return [];` (delete old check; return type unchanged).

Attendance server: getToday, getOverview and getRegister add noSchoolReason; registerPutBody gains optional holidayOverride; saveRegister rejects VALIDATION_ERROR (details.reason='HOLIDAY_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED') on a no-school date without it (D-8); route passes the flag through.

Attendance UI: landing shows 'No classes today — <reason>'; RegisterForm shows warning Alert when noSchoolReason is set and save goes through ConfirmDialog 'Record attendance on a holiday anyway' sending holidayOverride: true. Extend existing RegisterForm unit test.

Thin event routes: POST /api/events; GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/events/[id] (GET adds myRsvp, totals, canEdit); GET /api/events/[id]/ics (buildCalendar single event, download); PUT /api/events/[id]/rsvp; GET /api/events/[id]/rsvps (JSON or csv.ts). 404 when not visible, 403 forbidden, 409 RSVP closed.

Routes: GET /api/calendar (any user, getCalendarItems), GET /api/school-day?date= (new singular folder; /api/school-days untouched), POST /api/academic-years/[id]/term-breaks (ADMIN, createTermBreaks).

Token/public routes: GET /api/me/calendar-feed, POST /api/me/calendar-feed/reset (D-6), GET /api/calendar/feed/[token] (strip .ics, hashed lookup, rateLimit 60/h → 429 + Retry-After, text/calendar, Cache-Control private max-age=900, unknown → plain 404), GET /api/public/events (IP rateLimit 120/h, ≤100 days, D-9). Add '/api/calendar/feed/' and '/api/public/' to PUBLIC_API_PATHS and extend its unit test.

Shared AudienceBuilder (PRD-12 adopts as-is): rows of type Select + entity Autocomplete (grade level/section/course/role via existing APIs) + three include Checkboxes; client-side type filter mirrors canTargetAudience. MUI only.

EventEditorDialog: RHF + eventInputSchema; title, category (HOLIDAY/TERM_BREAK admin-only), all-day switch, @mui/x-date-pickers, location, MarkdownEditor, AudienceBuilder, recurrence + until, RSVP switch + deadline, admin-only isNoSchool/isPublic; POST/PATCH with useToast. MUI MCP lookup first (NFR-2).

EventDrawer (right Drawer): title, category Chip, school-tz time, location, MarkdownView, audience chips, RSVP ToggleButtonGroup + guests (parents) + note (disabled after deadline), totals, 'Add to my calendar' .ics link, edit (opens EventEditorDialog) / delete (ConfirmDialog) when canEdit, creator/admin RSVP DataTable + CSV link.

/calendar page: server page (requirePageUser) → CalendarView with EventCalendar (month/week/agenda, week 7–19, agenda 30 days, displayTimezone, readOnly), default view by 768px media query, controlled fetch on visible-date/view change with Map cache, ?event=<id> opens drawer, deadline click → router.push(href), parent child Select, 'New event' for ADMIN/TEACHER, Subscribe link; SourceChips persisted to localStorage; nav entry 'Calendar' for all roles. MUI MCP lookup first (NFR-2); D-5 agenda fallback only if QA rejects.

/account/calendar: server page + SubscribeCard client (read-only URL TextField, navigator.clipboard copy, Google/Apple/Outlook static instructions, 'Reset link' via ConfirmDialog; url null → prompt to reset, D-6).
Minimal /admin/academic-years/[id] page (requirePageRole ADMIN): year name, read-only term list from existing terms service, TermBreaksButton client with ConfirmDialog + toast showing created count.

AssignmentForm and QuizSettingsPanel: on dueAt/availableUntil change fetch /api/school-day?date=; if not a school day show non-blocking <Alert severity="warning">This date is a holiday (<title>).</Alert>; save unchanged.

seedCalendar() (idempotent, match by title): Thanksgiving break, Winter break TERM_BREAK, Semester 1 exams (3 GRADE_LEVEL audiences), Parent–teacher evening (RSVP, Grade 7 parents only), Science fair (public), weekly Chess club (Tuesdays, ROBOTICS course audience; seed ROBOTICS course if absent, D-7), Sports day (public, no announcement link).

Service integration tests: calendar merge per role (admin, teacher, student, parent with 3 children) incl. series mode; audience resolver parity across all seed users; isSchoolDay (weekday, holiday, recurring no-school) and createTermBreaks gap math/idempotency; RSVP reminder claimed once.

Route integration tests: teacher SCHOOL-audience create → 403; RSVP after deadline → 409; non-parent guests forced 0; feed token reset → old URL 404, new URL 200 and node-ical valid; feed 429 after limit.

Playwright: admin creates a holiday → teacher attendance landing shows 'No classes today — <holiday>' and student sees it on /calendar (no student Today view exists; NFR-11); parent RSVPs; feed URL from /account/calendar returns valid ICS.
